name: native-body-pan-and-front-camera-v1
purpose: Validate actual Jev-controlled left/right body yaw, heading-relative translation, and front-only target search.
sensor_contract: One 137.5-degree body-front RGB-D semantic camera; rear/up/down depth-only obstacle observations; no side cameras. No target detections from auxiliary views.
control_contract: Persistent forward_mps, up_mps, yaw_rate_rps. Positive yaw pans left. Independent partial assignments, explicit keep, 0.6-second wall-clock lease, revision checks. All navigation and yaw selected by Jev; PX4 stabilizes only.
scope: Three exploratory fresh-seed missions. Different sensing and action space from prior surround tests, not a matched performance comparison. Scripted body calibration is separate from autonomy evidence.
